diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service grants invoke permission on the function by name (local.cur_per_service_lambda_name), a plain string with no reference to the lambda module that creates the function. If module.cur_per_service hasn't been created yet when this permission is applied, AWS returns ResourceNotFoundException. Referencing the module's lambda_function_name output establishes the ordering implicitly.

aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource grants invoke permission on the function by name (local.cur_per_resource_lambda_name), a plain string with no reference to the lambda module that creates the function. If module.cur_per_resource hasn't been created yet when this permission is applied, AWS returns ResourceNotFoundException. Referencing the module's lambda_function_name output establishes the ordering implicitly.

aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process grants invoke permission on the function by name (local.cur_per_resource_process_lambda_name), a plain string with no reference to the lambda module that creates the function. If module.cur_per_resource_process hasn't been created yet when this permission is applied, AWS returns ResourceNotFoundException. Referencing the module's lambda_function_name output establishes the ordering implicitly.

aws_s3_bucket_notification.cur_notification configures an S3 trigger for the cur_per_resource_process lambda, but its depends_on only lists aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service and aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource — aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process is omitted. AWS validates that S3 is allowed to invoke each target function when the notification configuration is applied, so creating the notification before that permission exists fails.
